chunks: Return, you two sheikhs, from your opinion, for now the greatest of your matters is the disgrace, before the disgrace and the Hellfire are joined together; and peace.
ai.seo_question: What was Imam Ali's warning to Talha and Zubayr before the Battle of the Camel?
ai.summary: In this concise address to Talha and Zubayr, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) contrasts the temporal shame of their rebellion with the eternal punishment of the Hereafter, emphasizing the urgency of immediate repentance. This statement reflects the Shia scholarly view of the Battle of the Camel as a deviation from the rightful leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt, where the 'disgrace' refers to both political failure and spiritual loss. The warning underscores the principle that worldly conflict, if unjust, culminates in divine retribution, a theme central to Ali's sermons in Nahj al-Balagha.
